message: pip reads no configuration from the project, so pip.conf has no effect unless PIP_CONFIG_FILE points to it
fix: Set PIP_CONFIG_FILE=pip.conf where pip runs, or put the options in the requirements file pip installs from

message: pip does not accept --uploaded-prior-to in requirements files, so installing from requirements.txt fails
fix: Remove the line and set PIP_UPLOADED_PRIOR_TO where pip runs instead

message: pip does not accept --no-cache-dir in requirements files, so installing from requirements.txt fails
fix: Remove the line, and pass --no-cache-dir on the pip command line instead
